variants.name: day-classic
variants.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Image 1 is the approved geometry and face design. Image 2 is the original time-of-day palette reference.
Generate a complete single 3D clay-render hero scene by changing ONLY the time of day and lighting of image 1 to match image 2. Absolutely preserve image 1's composition, camera/FOV, central sphere's round silhouette and size, tilted ring angle, exact three people and their positions/poses/scale, orbit-chair, hairstyles, clothes, hands, flag, stars, dotted trajectories. Keep all original facial details identical: clean oval eyes, simple mouth, one tiny smooth rounded nose with continuous skin, no extra black dots or nostrils, no double features. Smooth high-quality skin and clean contours, no crunchy sharpening or texture noise.
Same wide canvas and same object coordinates as image 1, no zoom/crop/warp. No composite. A coherent whole-frame render, no lettering/watermark/border. Preserve native quality.
DAYTIME: precisely match image 2's soft neutral daylight and clean nearly white background, matte off-white planet with subtle neutral-gray shadows, soft pastel mint/turquoise right globe. Remove night nebula and night glow. Gentle natural peach skin and black hair, soft occlusion with no dirty black creases. Do not boost saturation or cyan; no vivid electric teal, HDR, haze, bleached skin or harsh contrast. Keep softly visible white clay stars and pastel mint dotted paths.
Use Image1's NEW WIDER framing exactly, not Image2's original tighter framing. Keep all main heads, stars and central planet inside the image's y90..650 region so the full illustrated vertical scene fits a32:9 panorama. No camera zoom or crop. Preserve the round planet and object positions. Reference2 is ONLY for neutral daylight colors.

variants.name: night-classic

Keep the foreground LARGE, comparable to the original; do not pull the camera far back or make tiny subjects. Keep the softly glowing night colors and subdued nebula exactly as shown. No new effects or saturation.
Output canvas highest quality panorama. If output canvas is2172x724, use these exact approximate staging coordinates so the central2144x603 artboard (x14..2158,y60..663) already contains the whole32:9 scene:
- The pale central planet BODY, excluding ring, is a circular sphere centered at x1395,y452 with diameter350px. It should extend from y277 to y627, never touch the bottom.
- Its tilted ring extends roughly x1160..1640, y320..570, natural ellipse.
- Seated boy's head at x1355,y156, hair top y102, feet near x1450,y322. Match his original smiling face, small smooth nose, clothes and pose.

- Turquoise globe has a broad curved top near y354 and spans off the lower and right image edges. DO NOT expose a complete separate small turquoise ball.
- Original star positions shift naturally with these proportions; keep decorative stars in y95..625.
- Left quiet navy space takes40% width; extend right edge naturally. Keep x0..2172 background continuous.
This is a freshly rendered whole scene with camera/composition adjusted to the extra horizontal field of view. Preserve facial identity and original tidy 3D clay art: clean eyes, tiny rounded noses, natural smiles; no extra face details, dark nose holes, crunchy outlines or melted features. No text, no watermark.

variants.name: night-nebula
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the approved night hero and the edit target. Image 2 shows the earlier vivid nebula style requested as an additional alternative.
Change ONLY the background space in image 1 to a richer, more elaborate blue/sapphire nebula inspired by image 2: layered delicate luminous cloud filaments, many tiny distant stars, a few crisp sparkling stars, depth and beautiful blue cosmic dust across the left and top background. Keep a dark navy base and legible negative space. The nebula should look beautiful and distinctly more elaborate than image 1, not a solid bright fog.
Preserve image 1's complete foreground without redesign: exact same three original clay people and poses, clean smooth faces, tiny understated noses, eyes/mouths, skin colors, hair, hands, clothing, white spherical planet with naturally elliptical tilted ring, turquoise globe, stars, dotted paths and flag. Keep the exact same composition, camera/FOV, position and object scale. NO flattened spheres or faces, no neon saturation added to skin/planets, no harsh sharpening, no broken facial details.
Do not increase foreground saturation/brightness at all; richer effects are only in distant background. Same native panoramic dimensions and margins as image 1. No composite, render one coherent full scene. Highest native quality clean PNG, no text, no watermark, no borders.
Keep Image1's wider32:9 safe composition exactly. Do not use Image2's tighter subject framing. No changes to camera, object scale or positions. Maintain the entire central sphere and all character heads within y90..650 of the source canvas.
